sectionBodies.getting-started: Fakamoʻoni hingoa, fili ho uooti ʻoku lolotonga ngāué, pea kamata mei he Dashboard. ʻOku makatuʻunga hoʻo ngaahi peesi mo e ngaahi ngāue ʻoku maʻú ʻi ho fatongia ʻi he uōtí mo e ngaahi meʻa ʻoku fakaʻatā.
sectionBodies.dashboard: Faka'aonga'i 'a e Dashboard ko ho'o hub muimui. ʻOkú ne ʻasi mai ʻa e fakataha hokó, ngaahi palaní, ngaahi laine ʻo e uiuiʻí mo e ouaú, ngaahi ʻinitaviú, ngaahi ngāue fakatakimuʻá, ngaahi fakatokanga, ngaahi hū mai, mateuteu ʻi he tekinolosiá, mo e tuʻunga ʻo e portal fakapuleʻangá.
sectionBodies.meetings: Fakaava ʻa e Ngaahi Fakatahá ke faʻu pe vakaiʻi ʻa e ngaahi fakataha fakauōtí. Mei he fakataha takitaha te ke lava ʻo fakatonutonu ʻa e polokalamá, fakaava ʻi he ʻAt the Stand, paaki ʻa e polokalamá, pea﻿—ʻo ka fakamafaiʻi﻿—tamateʻi ʻa e fakatahá.
sectionBodies.meeting-editor: Langa ʻa e polokalamá ʻi he hokohoko, tānaki atu ha kau lea mo ha ngaahi kaveinga, puleʻi ʻa e ngaahi himí mo e ngaahi fanongonongó, vakaiʻi ʻa e ngaahi meʻa fakapisinisí, tauhi ha ngaahi nouti, pulusi ha fakatātā fakapuleʻanga, pea tomuʻa vakaiʻi ʻa e ngaahi liliu kuo paaki pe fakapuleʻangá.
sectionBodies.at-the-stand: Ngāue‘aki ‘a e At the Stand lolotonga ‘a e fakatahá ki ha vakai fakahoko ‘oku lava ke lau. Fetongi ʻi he vahaʻa ʻo e ngaahi fokotuʻutuʻu angamahení mo e ngaahi fokotuʻutuʻu angamahení, vakaiʻi ʻa e ngaahi meʻa fakapisinisí mo e polokalamá, pea fakaʻaongaʻi ʻa e ngaahi fehokotakiʻanga fakaʻofisiale ʻo e Siasí ʻi he feituʻu ʻoku ʻoatú.
sectionBodies.offline: ʻOku ʻotomētiki pē ʻa e hū ʻi he ʻinitanetí hili hono fakaava ha fakataha kuo fakamafaiʻi. Kapau 'oku 'ikai lava 'a e fehokotaki'anga, 'Oku fakahaa'i 'e he Tu'unga 'a e snapshot fakalotofonua fo'ou taha kuo fakamafai'i, hono ta'u motu'a, mo e ngaahi liliu 'oku kei tatali. ʻOku fakafuofuaʻi ʻa e fakamatala fakatāutahá ki he tokotaha ʻoku fakamoʻoni hingoá, uōtí, mo e fakatahá.
sectionBodies.business: Fakaʻaongaʻi ʻa e ngaahi feituʻu ngāue ʻo e pisinisí mo e kāingalotú ke muimuiʻi ʻa e tuʻunga ʻo e fakaʻaliʻalí mo e muimuiʻí. Ko e Tuʻunga ko ha laʻipepa fakafekauʻaki; ʻoku ʻikai ke ne fetongi ʻa e LCR pe ngaahi founga fakaʻofisiale kehe ʻa e Siasí.
sectionBodies.leadership: ʻOku tauhi ʻe he pīsopelikí, Fakataha Alēlea ʻo e Uōtí, fakafekauʻaki ʻo e kau faifekaú, ʻinitaviú, mo e ngaahi lisi vakaiʻi ʻo e tekinolosiá ke fokotuʻutuʻu ʻa e ngāue fakangāué ʻi ha ngaahi feituʻu ngāue fakatāutaha, ʻoku fakauōtí.
sectionBodies.notifications: Pule'i 'a e ngaahi totongi 'o e ngaahi me'a 'oku hoko mo e ngaahi manako 'o e tu'uaki 'i he Settings. 'Oku fakahaa'i 'e he senitaa fakatokanga ho'o ngaahi fakatokanga 'i he app; diagnostics 'oku ma'u ia 'e he kau pule kuo fakamafai'i.
sectionBodies.imports: Faka'aonga'i 'a e ngaahi peesi 'o e import ki he tomu'a sio-'uluaki memipa, ui, mo e polokalama fakahisitolia 'o e fakamatala workflows. Toe vakaiʻi ʻa e tomuʻa vakaiʻí kimuʻa peá ke fakahoko ha ngaahi liliú. ʻOku fakanounouʻi ʻe he ngaahi lipōtí ʻa e ngaahi fakamatala fakauooti kuo fokotuʻutuʻú pea ʻoku ʻikai ke nau tohi ki he ngaahi sisitemi ʻa e Siasí.
sectionBodies.public-programs: Pulusi pē ‘a e ngaahi me‘a ‘oku fakataumu‘a ki ha kau fanongo fakapule‘anga. Ko e ngaahi fehokotaki'anga fakapule'anga mo e ngaahi portals 'oku nau ngaue 'aki 'a e ngaahi snapshots kuo pulusi, 'ikai ko e fakamatala fakataha fakafo'ituitui mo'ui. Toe pulusi hili hono liliu ʻo e kakano ʻoku totonu ke ʻasi fakahāhā.
sectionBodies.settings: Fakaʻaongaʻi ʻa e Ngaahi Fakatonutonú ki he leá, fōtungá, ngaahi fakatokanga, ngaahi meʻa ʻi he uōtí, fokotuʻutuʻu fakapuleʻangá, fokotuʻutuʻu ʻo e portal, mo e hū ʻa e tokotaha fakaʻaongaʻí ʻi he feituʻu ʻoku fakaʻatā ai ʻe ho fatongiá. ʻOku ʻi he ngaahi peesi ʻo e ʻakauní ʻa e ngaahi meʻa ʻokú ke saiʻia aí mo e ngaahi ngāue ʻo e lea fufuú.
sectionBodies.privacy: ʻOku fakamavaheʻi ʻa e fakamatala ʻo e uōtí mo e tokotaha fakaʻaongaʻí ʻe he ngaahi ngataʻanga ʻo e fakamafaiʻí. ʻOku kei fakatāutaha pē ʻa e ngaahi fakamatala fakatāutahá, ʻoku mahino ʻa e ngaahi tā fakapuleʻangá, pea ʻoku ʻikai lau pe tohi ʻa e The Stand ki he LCR pe ngaahi sisitemi kehe ʻa e Siasí.
